messages:
Maria A.: Hey team — hit a blocker on the Pinecrest POC order. Procurement says they won't release the PO until MSA indemnity and liability cap are narrowed and they have a signed order form. Who can own legal redlines?
Ben (Legal): Thanks — can you drop their redline PDF here and confirm counterparty entity name + wanted signature flow?
Maria A.: Link uploaded: https://redwood.internal/attachments/pinecrest-msaredline.pdf. They redlined indemnity (broad), bumped liability cap to $5M, and requested DPA language pointing to EU data residency.
Olivia (Product): For SLA: we committed to 99.9% for prod. Do we have approval to move price if they demand higher SLA or extra retention?
Sam (Security): Procurement also asked for KMS/HSM detail and SOC2 doc + SCCs. I have the attestation template ready — will attach in thread.
Ella (Ops): Procurement wants the DocuSign envelope routed to procurement@pinecrest.io then CFO. They asked whether wet-ink is needed for the UK entity.
Ben (Legal): Quick take: we should push the cap to $3M, carve out gross negligence and IP claims. Unlimited indemnity is a no. I'll prepare a redline counter and a succinct rationale for procurement.
Maria A.: PO number required for billing; they said tentative PO 478312 but internal approver (Jordan, procurement lead) needs countersign first. Also finance asked if we can accept Net60 — they usually require Net30.
Olivia (Product): Note on pricing: POC discount window closes on countersigned order form. If Net60 pushes cashflow issues, we may need to reduce discount.
Ben (Legal): I'll assemble a clean MSA + tracked comments. @docusign-bot can you prepare an envelope with recipients: procurement@pinecrest.io, cfo@pinecrest.io, contracts@redwood.com and attach Order Form + MSA draft?
docusign-bot: Envelope created (draft): https://docusign.internal/env/67890 — will send after Ben approves and I receive final recipient order.
Sam (Security): Uploaded attestation and KMS writeup: https://redwood.internal/security/attestations/pinecrest-kms.pdf. If they insist on HSM-in-scope language, escalate to CISO.
Ella (Ops): Billing ops: once PO is cleared, invoice goes to invoices@pinecrest.io and cc finance@redwood.com — include PO on invoice header and order form reference.
Ben (Legal): Draft ready — sending to internal signers now. If procurement insists on the HSM clause or expanded DPA residency, we'll need an approved exception.
Maria A.: I'll ping Jordan and ask for expedited sign route once you mark envelope ready. Will update thread after procurement confirms PO issuance. :thumbsup:
